title: From Few to Many: Self-Improving Many-Shot Reasoners Through Iterative Optimization and Generation
problem: Naively scaling in-context demonstrations wastes context and produces unstable reasoning performance.
assumption_broken: Many-shot gains need not require retaining all available examples because a small influential subset can drive performance.
operational_signature: Generate → filter → optimize subsets → regenerate → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: BRIDGE alternates Bayesian selection of influential demonstrations with regeneration of training rationales conditioned on that subset.
limitations_evident: Focuses on roughly 150–200 labeled samples.
Requires labeled final answers to filter generated demonstrations.

title: Strategist: Self-improvement of LLM Decision Making via Bi-Level Tree Search
problem: LLMs struggle to learn and execute robust policies in adversarial multi-agent environments without expensive training.
assumption_broken: Policy learning can optimize compact textual or coded strategy abstractions rather than directly learning every action decision.
operational_signature: Simulate → diagnose discrepancies → propose ideas → revise strategies → compete → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: A bandit-scored reusable improvement-idea queue guides high-level strategy revisions whose policies are refined and evaluated through MCTS self-play.
limitations_evident: Evaluated on two games with simulators.
Human comparison contains only 30 games.
Human ratings identify weaker reasoning, deduction, and cooperation.

title: GReaTer: Gradients Over Reasoning Makes Smaller Language Models Strong Prompt Optimizers
problem: Textual-feedback prompt optimization depends on expensive large models because smaller models produce weak optimization feedback.
assumption_broken: Small models can optimize their own discrete prompts using numerical gradients through generated reasoning instead of larger-model critiques.
operational_signature: Propose tokens → generate reasoning → extract logits → differentiate → replace → retain best
load_bearing_mechanism: Task-loss gradients conditioned on generated reasoning rank model-proposed prompt tokens before forward evaluation selects replacements.
limitations_evident: Requires gradient and logit access to the target model.
Requires labeled task examples and an answer-extraction format.

title: SFS: Smarter Code Space Search improves LLM Inference Scaling
problem: Inference-time code search repeatedly generates similar solutions and gets trapped in unproductive regions.
assumption_broken: Exploration diversity can be controlled through explicit textual directions and multiple search roots rather than repeated sampling from one prompt.
operational_signature: Diversify starts → propose directions → edit → test → share insights → branch
load_bearing_mechanism: Scattered Forest Search combines direction-conditioned branching, multiple diverse roots, and shared feedback insights to diversify MCTS code search.
limitations_evident: Inaccurate generated validation tests can reject a correct solution.
Only 200 APPS problems are sampled because of budget constraints.
Equal solution counts do not establish equal token costs.

title: DataEnvGym: Data Generation Agents in Teacher Environments with Student Feedback
problem: Creating targeted training data still requires humans to interpret model weaknesses and manually steer data generation.
assumption_broken: The curriculum and synthetic-data allocation can be autonomous sequential decisions driven by student feedback rather than fixed human plans.
operational_signature: Evaluate → diagnose skills → plan data → generate → train → reevaluate
load_bearing_mechanism: Teacher environments close the loop between student errors, structured data-generation actions, and retraining of the student.
limitations_evident: Requires repeated student training and evaluation.
Baseline skill-tree policy uses a fixed tree size and uniform data distribution.
Structured environments restrict teacher actions to the supplied scaffolding.

title: Can Textual Gradient Work in Federated Learning?
problem: Federated optimization of black-box LLM prompts must aggregate heterogeneous textual updates without losing useful information or exceeding context limits.
assumption_broken: Federated learning can communicate and aggregate natural-language prompt updates instead of numerical model parameters.
operational_signature: Distribute → evaluate locally → critique → rewrite → aggregate → redistribute
load_bearing_mechanism: FedTextGrad aggregates locally text-gradient-optimized prompts using summarization guided by uniform information density.
limitations_evident: Concatenated prompts can exceed context windows.
Summarization may discard critical information.
Performance is sensitive to local steps, batch sizes, and client heterogeneity.

title: B-STaR: Monitoring and Balancing Exploration and Exploitation in Self-Taught Reasoners
problem: Iterative self-training stagnates as response diversity and reward-based discrimination cease to remain well balanced.
assumption_broken: Sampling temperature and reward thresholds need not remain fixed as the policy changes during self-training.
operational_signature: Probe → balance configurations → sample → reward → filter → train → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: A balance score jointly measures the quantity and purity of distinct correct solutions to adapt sampling temperature and reward thresholds each iteration.

improver_modified.how: The self-training loop adapts its own generation temperature and reward-filter threshold as the generating policy is updated.

limitations_evident: Correct final answers can conceal incorrect intermediate reasoning.
The reward model remains fixed as the policy changes.
Balance-score estimation needs verifiable correctness on a training subset.

title: Pareto Prompt Optimization
problem: Single-objective or scalarized prompt optimization cannot reliably cover trade-offs among conflicting output objectives.
assumption_broken: Prompt optimization can learn from pairwise dominance without assuming a predefined scalar reward or fixed objective weights.
operational_signature: Sample prompt pairs → evaluate objectives → compare dominance → update proposer → refresh reference
load_bearing_mechanism: Dominance-preference losses favor dominating prompts while a non-dominated-pair loss preserves diverse trade-offs in the prompt-generation policy.

improver_modified.how: Preference-based training updates the adapter of the policy that generates optimized prompts and periodically refreshes its reference policy.

limitations_evident: Dominating pairs become scarce as the number of objectives grows.
Non-dominated pairs do not directly indicate how to improve prompts.
Requires training access to a prompt-generating policy.

title: LLM-SR: Scientific Equation Discovery via Programming with Large Language Models
problem: Symbolic regression must navigate a vast combinatorial equation space without effectively using scientific prior knowledge.
assumption_broken: Equation discovery need not be restricted to expression trees or search based on observations alone.
operational_signature: Retrieve hypotheses → propose structures → fit parameters → score → archive improvements → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-SR combines scientific-prior-conditioned program skeleton generation with numerical parameter fitting and island-based reuse of high-scoring hypotheses.
limitations_evident: Evaluation uses four custom benchmark problems.
LLMs may recite familiar equations instead of discovering them.
Malformed or timed-out equation programs are discarded.

title: OMNI-EPIC: Open-endedness via Models of human Notions of Interestingness with Environments Programmed in Code
problem: Open-ended curricula are confined to narrow hand-parameterized environment distributions.
assumption_broken: Both simulated worlds and reward functions can be generated as code rather than chosen from fixed environment templates.
operational_signature: Retrieve stepping stones → propose tasks → program environments → screen novelty → train → archive outcomes
load_bearing_mechanism: Foundation models use an expanding archive of learned and failed tasks to generate novel learnable environments and rewards as executable programs.
limitations_evident: Implementation is restricted to the PyBullet simulator.
Main agent has only six discrete actions because of compute limits.
Preliminary VLM success detectors were insufficiently accurate.

title: MAC-CAFE: Multi-actor, Centralized Critic Architecture for Feedback-driven Editing
problem: Incorrect or incomplete retrieval documents cause RAG failures that cannot be fixed reliably by merely adding more documents.
assumption_broken: Expert feedback can directly optimize the external knowledge base instead of changing model parameters or only fixing individual answers.
operational_signature: Retrieve → answer → obtain feedback → assign document credit → edit sections → evaluate states
load_bearing_mechanism: A centralized critic clusters failure reflections into document-specific textual gradients that decentralized editors apply within MCTS over knowledge-base states.
limitations_evident: Assumes expert feedback identifies errors caused by the knowledge base.
Large knowledge bases require document- and section-level decomposition.
The space of possible edits is too large for exhaustive search.

title: Gödel Agent: A Self-Referential Framework Helps for Recursively Self-Improvement
problem: Fixed agent pipelines and fixed meta-optimizers restrict the agent designs that automated improvement can discover.
assumption_broken: The improvement algorithm itself can be inspected and rewritten rather than remaining a fixed outer loop.
operational_signature: Inspect self → evaluate → reason → patch policy and improver → recurse
load_bearing_mechanism: Runtime introspection and monkey patching let an LLM rewrite both task policy and recursive self-improvement logic.

improver_modified.how: The agent can modify the code that analyzes and modifies itself, including its recursive improvement and action routines.

limitations_evident: Unconstrained runs may change the model API or access external information.
Execution errors require an added recovery mechanism.
Results depend on the initial policy and supportive tools.

title: PromptWizard: Task-Aware Prompt Optimization Framework
problem: Effective prompts require jointly choosing instructions and informative demonstrations without excessive optimization calls.
assumption_broken: Instructions and demonstrations can be refined together rather than treating examples as a fixed input.
operational_signature: Mutate → evaluate → critique → synthesize → refine examples → deploy
load_bearing_mechanism: Task-specific critiques jointly refine instruction mutations and informative positive and negative examples.
limitations_evident: Requires task examples for scoring and demonstration selection.
Uses predefined thinking styles and a fixed optimization scaffold.

title: Task Facet Learning: A Structured Approach to Prompt Optimization
problem: Unstructured prompt edits from heterogeneous failures interfere with one another and generalize poorly.
assumption_broken: Prompts can be decomposed into independently editable semantic sections and optimized using coherent task facets.
operational_signature: Cluster → diagnose → aggregate feedback → edit sections → rank beam → stop
load_bearing_mechanism: UniPrompt aggregates minibatch feedback within coherent task clusters into section-level edits while maintaining a two-prompt beam.
limitations_evident: Requires labeled training examples and an expert feedback model.
Uses validation accuracy for early stopping.
Depends on clustering examples into meaningful facets.

title: MetaAgent: Automatically Building Multi-Agent System based on Finite State Machine
problem: Automatically designed multi-agent systems lack flexible tool-enabled workflows that generalize across cases in a task domain.
assumption_broken: Agent roles and communication transitions can be generated and revised instead of fixed as a human-designed linear workflow.
operational_signature: Design roles → construct states → generate tests → inspect failures → revise → deploy
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-generated primary and edge-case trajectories guide simplification and revision of a finite-state multi-agent workflow with backward transitions.
limitations_evident: Available tools are selected from a predefined pool.
Self-generated tests chiefly optimize workflow structure.
Deployment has a maximum transition count.

title: Large Language Models Are Active Critics in NLG Evaluation
problem: Fixed human-written criteria make NLG evaluators difficult to adapt to new tasks and stakeholder preferences.
assumption_broken: Evaluation criteria and demonstration choices can be inferred from rated examples rather than predefined by developers.
operational_signature: Infer task → derive criteria → sample demonstrations → score → correlate → select
load_bearing_mechanism: Active-Critic selects demonstrations by the sum of Pearson, Spearman, and Kendall correlations with human ratings after inferring task-specific criteria.
limitations_evident: Requires human-rated training examples.
Correlation estimates depend on a small labeled set.

title: Evolving Alignment via Asymmetric Self-Play
problem: Alignment on a fixed prompt distribution wastes training effort and generalizes poorly to novel requests.
assumption_broken: The prompt distribution can evolve with solver capabilities rather than remain fixed during preference training.
operational_signature: Sample responses → estimate reward spread → prioritize prompts → evolve variants → optimize solver → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: A creator evolves prompts with large best-versus-worst response reward gaps to supply a learnable curriculum for preference optimization.
limitations_evident: Relies on a reward model as a proxy for human preference.
Regret is approximated by finite response samples.
The practical creator is heuristic rather than differentiable.

title: PLHF: Prompt Learning from Few-shot Human Feedback
problem: Prompt optimization for subjective generation lacks a reliable metric and repeated human scoring is expensive.
assumption_broken: The scoring metric can itself be prompt-optimized from a single batch of human feedback.
operational_signature: Collect ratings → optimize evaluator → score responses → optimize responder → optionally refresh
load_bearing_mechanism: A few-shot human-calibrated evaluator replaces repeated human calls while guiding responder prompt optimization.

improver_modified.how: The evaluator prompt that supplies the responder optimizer’s scoring signal is itself optimized against human ratings.

limitations_evident: Requires a batch of human-scored examples.
Responder optimization depends on evaluator fidelity.
Incremental adaptation requires additional human feedback.

title: Contextual Experience Replay for Continual Learning of Language Agents
problem: Web agents repeatedly rediscover environment dynamics and decision patterns instead of learning from previous interactions.
assumption_broken: Continual learning can occur through retrieved contextual experience without updating model weights.
operational_signature: Act → distill trajectories → merge memories → retrieve relevant experience → replay in context
load_bearing_mechanism: CER distills both successful and failed trajectories into reusable environment dynamics and abstract skills retrieved for later tasks.
limitations_evident: Main evaluation learns online from earlier benchmark tasks.
Distillation and retrieval use GPT-4o.
Experiences are environment-specific.

title: MAGE: Leveraging LLMs for Automated Mapper Generation in Parallel Programming
problem: Writing high-performance application- and machine-specific parallel mappers requires lengthy expert systems programming.
assumption_broken: Mapper decisions can be searched as compact DSL programs rather than manually implemented low-level C++ policies.
operational_signature: Generate mapper → compile → execute → measure → diagnose → revise generator
load_bearing_mechanism: A constrained mapping DSL and Trace-mediated execution feedback let an LLM revise decision procedures that generate high-throughput mappers.

improver_modified.how: Trace updates the executable decision procedures used to generate mapper programs, rather than only editing one mapper output.

limitations_evident: Implemented for the Legion framework and a dedicated mapper DSL.
Mappers depend on application inputs and machine architecture.
Templates require mapping heuristics and explanatory docstrings.

title: HessianGrad: Optimizing AI Systems with Hessian-Aware Textual Gradients
problem: Immediate textual feedback can repeat ineffective edits and stall optimization.
assumption_broken: Response changes across iterations can guide edits instead of using only the current critique.
operational_signature: Execute → critique → compare response history → refine feedback → update → validate
load_bearing_mechanism: HessianGrad augments textual gradients with an LLM-assessed similarity signal between successive responses to adapt updates.
limitations_evident: The Hessian analogy uses language-model judgments rather than numerical second derivatives.
Feedback quality depends on the optimizer model.
One Gemini prompt-optimization setting trails TextGrad.

title: MorphAgent: Empowering Agents through Self-Evolving Profiles and Decentralized Collaboration
problem: Static roles and centralized coordination make multi-agent systems brittle to changing tasks and node failures.
assumption_broken: Roles can continuously evolve through decentralized profile updates rather than remain predefined.
operational_signature: Initialize profiles → score clarity and complementarity → revise → act → reflect → adapt
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-evolving profiles are guided by role clarity, role differentiation, and task-role alignment metrics to maintain complementary specialization.
limitations_evident: Profile metrics are linguistic and embedding-based proxies for actual competence.
The system still uses auxiliary middleware for environmental interaction.

title: Skill Discovery using Language Models
problem: Robot planning depends on predefined skills and unreliable reward parameters impede automatic skill acquisition.
assumption_broken: Skills and their termination conditions can be generated and parameterized rather than supplied as a fixed library.
operational_signature: Decompose → generate rewards → train parameterized skills → tune predecessors → retain → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: L2S postpones choosing reward and termination parameters until downstream skill training reveals which predecessor outcomes are useful.
limitations_evident: Requires an environment abstraction and few-shot reward-generation examples.
Parameter distributions are configured by the user.
Evaluation is on simulated robot manipulation tasks.

title: Verbalized Bayesian Persuasion
problem: Classical scalar game models lose natural-language nuance while direct policy optimization in dialogue is difficult.
assumption_broken: Persuasion strategies can be represented and optimized as prompts while retaining game-theoretic solution structure.
operational_signature: Represent game → simulate strategies → solve meta-game → propose best responses → expand strategy sets
load_bearing_mechanism: VBP combines a prompt-space response oracle with conditional prompt optimization and verbalized commitment and obedience constraints.
limitations_evident: Requires specified game utilities and a verbalized game mapping.
Realistic scenarios are generated and played by language models.
Best-response optimization is approximate.

title: Matchmaker: Schema Matching with self-improving compositional LLM programs
problem: Schema heterogeneity makes reliable matching difficult without substantial labeled training data.
assumption_broken: A compositional matcher can improve using synthetic demonstrations rather than labeled examples.
operational_signature: Generate candidates → refine → score confidence → synthesize demonstrations → guide reasoning
load_bearing_mechanism: Matchmaker constructs synthetic in-context demonstrations to improve a compositional schema-matching program without labeled demonstrations.

title: Beyond In-Context Learning: Enhancing Long-form Generation of Large Language Models via Task-Inherent Attribute Guidelines
problem: Demonstrations alone inadequately convey the language and format distributions needed for long-form generation.
assumption_broken: Task distributions can be explicitly expressed as generated guidelines instead of implicitly inferred from demonstrations.
operational_signature: Generate metric guidelines → generate output constraints → combine → evaluate → select
load_bearing_mechanism: LongGuide selects combinations of self-evaluated metric guidelines and token- and sentence-level output constraints.

title: Proposer-Agent-Evaluator (PAE): Autonomous Skill Discovery For Foundation Model Internet Agents
problem: Manually specifying practice tasks limits the scale and diversity of Internet-agent skills.
assumption_broken: Agents can autonomously propose practice tasks and obtain model-generated rewards rather than depend on a fixed human curriculum.
operational_signature: Propose contextual tasks → execute → evaluate success → reinforce policy → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: A context-aware task proposer and autonomous trajectory-success evaluator supply web practice and rewards for reinforcement learning.

title: Stealix: Model Stealing via Prompt Evolution
problem: Synthetic-data model stealing depends on manually crafted prompts and knowledge of target classes.
assumption_broken: Synthetic image prompts can be evolved without class names or expert prompt design.
operational_signature: Infer distribution → synthesize images → score proxy → evolve prompts → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: A genetic algorithm refines prompts using a proxy metric to improve synthetic-image precision and diversity for model stealing.

problem: Prompt-space off-policy gradients for personalized generation have high variance or biased reward estimates.
assumption_broken: Feedback must be attributed through prompt actions rather than similarities between generated outputs.
operational_signature: Collect feedback → compare outputs → estimate updates → optimize instructions
load_bearing_mechanism: Direct Sentence Off-policy gradient shares logged feedback through sentence similarity to reduce gradient variance while suppressing bias.
title: Prompt Optimization with Logged Bandit Data

problem: Automatically generated vision-language prompts do not reliably match the language preferred by downstream visual models.
assumption_broken: The proposing model must remain internally unaltered while optimization operates only through input examples.
operational_signature: Propose candidates → rank outcomes → contrast representations → steer proposals
load_bearing_mechanism: GLOV adds the embedding difference between positive and negative prior solutions to an intermediate LLM layer while supplying ranked prompts as examples.

improver_modified.how: The proposer receives an intermediate-layer activation offset computed from positive and negative prior solutions; weight training is not stated.

title: GLOV: Guided Large Language Models as Implicit Optimizers for Vision Language Models

problem: Centralized model adaptation threatens data and model privacy, while local LLM deployment is computationally expensive.
assumption_broken: Federated adaptation requires access to model internals or communication of weight updates.
operational_signature: Propose tokens → measure accuracy → filter contributions → aggregate instructions
load_bearing_mechanism: FedDTPT combines accuracy-driven discrete token optimization through an MLM API with server-side semantic attention, elbow detection, and clustering.
title: FedDTPT: Federated Discrete and Transferable Prompt Tuning for Black-Box Large Language Models

problem: Table reasoning requires effective prompts for both intermediate reasoning and function calls without model fine-tuning.
assumption_broken: All useful task priors must be encoded correctly in a fixed initial prompting pipeline.
operational_signature: Execute steps → critique results → propagate feedback → revise components
load_bearing_mechanism: TableTextGrad uses LLM textual feedback to iteratively refine individual functions throughout reasoning and function-call pipelines.
title: TableTextGrad: A Reflexive Framework for Tabuar Understanding

problem: Retrieving only a few raw chunks prevents LLMs from effectively exploiting very large external knowledge collections.
assumption_broken: Retrieval memory must consist of raw documents rather than reusable intermediate responses from prior queries.
operational_signature: Generate intermediates → remove redundancy → organize memory → retrieve experience
load_bearing_mechanism: Thought-Retriever filters and stores intermediate responses as thought memory for retrieval on subsequent queries.
title: Thought-Retriever: Don’t Just Retrieve Raw Data, Retrieve Thoughts

problem: Pixel-based agents struggle to reuse skills in long-horizon tasks, while symbolic methods depend on manually designed predicates.
assumption_broken: Reusable skills and their symbolic planning interpretations must be supplied by human experts.
operational_signature: Collect experience → discover primitives → evolve abstractions → compose plans
load_bearing_mechanism: Automatically learned entity-centric skills receive genetic-algorithm-derived symbolic interpretations, turning complex control into compositional planning.
title: From Skills to Plans: Automatic Skill Discovery and Symbolic Interpretation for Compositional Tasks

problem: Combinatorial optimization heuristics adapt poorly and require substantial manual tuning or problem-specific training data.
assumption_broken: Heuristic design, adaptation, evaluation, and selection need to be separate human-driven processes.
operational_signature: Generate candidates → evolve variants → benchmark behavior → select solutions
load_bearing_mechanism: HeurAgenix assigns heuristic generation, evolution, benchmark evaluation, and selection to cooperating LLM agents.
title: HeurAgenix: A Multi-Agent LLM-Based Paradigm for Adaptive Heuristic Evolution and Selection in Combinatorial Optimization

problem: Prompt creation is difficult and existing optimization approaches incur many interactions while underusing textual feedback.
assumption_broken: Prompt optimization must rely mainly on numerical rewards or expensive weight updates.
operational_signature: Act with instructions → collect feedback → rewrite instructions → repeat interaction
load_bearing_mechanism: A prompted LLM acts as an optimizer that treats the task prompt as a textual parameter and updates it from environment feedback.
title: Text as parameter: interactive prompt optimisation for large language models

problem: Designing exact combinatorial optimization solver algorithms requires expertise and exploration of a large discrete space.
assumption_broken: Solver policies must be designed manually or searched from scratch in a symbolic representation.
operational_signature: Generate programs → evaluate behavior → evolve candidates → deploy algorithms
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM4Solver uses pretrained language-model knowledge to generate programs and derivative-free evolution to optimize solver algorithms.
title: LLM4Solver: Large Language Model for Efficient Algorithm Design of Combinatorial Optimization Solver

problem: Guided text-to-image diffusion sampling favors high-density outputs and underproduces useful minority instances.
assumption_broken: The user prompt must stay fixed while sampling alone controls the rarity of generated outputs.
operational_signature: Condition generation → estimate likelihood → optimize instructions → generate rare outputs
load_bearing_mechanism: Online prompt optimization uses a tailored likelihood objective to encourage low-density conditional features while preserving user semantics.
title: MinorityPrompt: Text to Minority Image Generation via Prompt Optimization

problem: Human-directed acquisition of LLM training data is costly, potentially suboptimal, and difficult to scale.
assumption_broken: Humans must diagnose a model and decide which training data it should acquire next.
operational_signature: Diagnose needs → acquire examples → retrain capabilities → reward gains
load_bearing_mechanism: Models learn to invoke data-crawling and generation APIs using reinforcement feedback that rewards performance gains and penalizes compute overhead.

improver_modified.how: The data-acquiring models retrain themselves, and reinforcement feedback shapes their future data-selection decisions.

title: Let Large Language Models Find the Data to Train Themselves

problem: Code-generation models fail to align with user intent on specialized tasks and edge cases.
assumption_broken: Coding adaptation must rely only on fixed training data rather than persistent knowledge and immediate execution feedback.
operational_signature: Generate artifacts → collect feedback → update memories → adapt behavior
load_bearing_mechanism: FALCON combines global long-term knowledge retention with local compiler and AI feedback through bi-level meta-reinforcement learning.
title: FALCON: A Feedback-Driven Adaptive Long/Short-Term Memory Reinforced Coding Optimization

problem: Static, human, and model-based LLM evaluations suffer from saturation, overfitting, cost, and bias.
assumption_broken: Model capability must be measured against a static benchmark under manually chosen prompting strategies.
operational_signature: Stage competition → observe outcomes → optimize instructions → reassess capability
load_bearing_mechanism: ZeroSumEval combines dynamic zero-sum competition with automatic prompt optimization to reduce human-prompting bias in model comparisons.
title: ZeroSumEval: Scaling LLM Evaluation with Inter-Model Competition

problem: LLM root-cause diagnosis is derailed by hallucinated actions and complex, noisy incident evidence.
assumption_broken: Root-cause agents should freely choose each next action without reusable procedural constraints.
operational_signature: Retrieve procedures → synthesize missing guidance → compile actions → constrain execution
load_bearing_mechanism: An SOP-centric tool flow retrieves or generates diagnostic procedures and converts them into code that constrains the main agent at key decision points.
title: Flow-of-Action: SOP Enhanced LLM-Based Multi-Agent System for Root Cause Analysis

problem: Static agent workflows cannot adapt, while per-query optimization discards accumulated specialist expertise.
assumption_broken: Agent designs must either stay fixed or be rebuilt independently for each new query.
operational_signature: Discover specialists → cultivate expertise → retain structure → escalate adaptation
load_bearing_mechanism: ASpec combines evolutionary specialist discovery with stateful experience accumulation and a retain-then-escalate controller.
title: Automated Stateful Specialization for Adaptive Agent Systems

problem: Multimodal verifiers over-validate agent behavior, weakening failure detection and downstream self-improvement.
assumption_broken: A verifier should assess a candidate trajectory directly before independently specifying desired behavior.
operational_signature: Elicit independent expectations → condition judgment → evaluate behavior → supervise improvement
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-Grounded Verification first generates desired-behavior priors independently of the candidate, then evaluates the trajectory conditioned on those priors.
limitations_evident: Agreement bias persists across models and is resilient to test-time scaling.
title: Let's Think in Two Steps: Mitigating Agreement Bias in MLLMs with Self-Grounded Verification

problem: Rigid linear search-agent tool chains cannot adapt their structure to diverse queries and tool-use needs.
assumption_broken: Web information seeking should follow a fixed reactive tool sequence rather than synthesize experience-conditioned workflows.
operational_signature: Decompose objectives → retrieve experience → synthesize structure → consolidate experience
load_bearing_mechanism: FlowSearcher synthesizes subgoal-specific workflow graphs using hierarchical memory that consolidates reusable structural experience from past workflows.
title: FlowSearcher: Synthesizing Memory-Guided Agentic Workflows for Web Information Seeking

problem: Fixed or speculatively induced visual-programming tools produce weak programs and are poorly reused for spatial reasoning.
assumption_broken: Useful tools must be predefined or invented before there is evidence of recurring solution patterns.
operational_signature: Solve instances → store solutions → abstract patterns → reuse tools
load_bearing_mechanism: TVP abstracts recurring patterns from an accumulated Example Library into higher-level tools in an evolving Tool Library.
title: Transductive Visual Programming: Evolving Tool Libraries from Experience for Spatial Reasoning

problem: Text-only prompt optimization neglects the non-textual inputs that shape multimodal model performance.
assumption_broken: Only the textual part of a multimodal prompt should be optimized.
operational_signature: Propose paired inputs → preserve alignment → evaluate candidates → select using priors
load_bearing_mechanism: MPO jointly updates textual and non-textual prompts while preserving alignment and uses prior evaluations in Bayesian candidate selection.
title: Multimodal Prompt Optimization: Why Not Leverage Multiple Modalities for MLLMs

problem: Efficient prompt selection must handle conflicting performance criteria rather than a single score.
assumption_broken: A prompt can be selected adequately by optimizing one scalar performance metric.
operational_signature: Measure candidates → allocate evaluations → resolve tradeoffs → identify solutions
load_bearing_mechanism: Pure-exploration multi-objective bandits recover Pareto prompt sets or identify the best feasible prompt with structured-bandit guarantees.
limitations_evident: The stated structured-bandit identification-error guarantee applies to the linear case.
title: Efficient Multi-objective Prompt Optimization via Pure-exploration Bandits

problem: In-context learning becomes expensive when task adaptation requires long collections of examples.
assumption_broken: Adapting to a new dataset requires retaining its examples in the downstream model context.
operational_signature: Observe examples → induce instructions → measure performance → train proposer
load_bearing_mechanism: Prompt-MII uses reinforcement meta-learning across diverse classification datasets to train a model that compresses examples into compact task instructions.

improver_modified.how: Reinforcement learning meta-trains the instruction-induction model that proposes prompts for new datasets.

title: Prompt-MII: Meta-Learning Instruction Induction for LLMs

problem: Automated black-box adversarial prompt search must navigate language-dependent weaknesses in LLM safety constraints.
assumption_broken: Common modern-language phrasing is the only useful search space for adversarial prompts.
operational_signature: Encode candidates → explore variants → assess responses → mutate candidates
load_bearing_mechanism: CC-BOS applies multi-dimensional fruit-fly search and Cauchy mutation to classical Chinese prompts, with translation supporting evaluation.
title: Obscure but Effective: Classical Chinese Jailbreak Prompt Optimization via Bio-Inspired Search

problem: Skills learned by web agents are over-specialized to individual websites and fail to transfer.
assumption_broken: A reusable skill must bind its abstract objective to one concrete execution implementation.
operational_signature: Explore interactions → abstract objectives → separate implementations → compose reusable skills
load_bearing_mechanism: PolySkill uses polymorphic abstraction to decouple skill goals from concrete implementations, supporting compositional cross-site reuse and self-directed curricula.

improver_modified.how: The agent identifies and refines its own goals, changing the curriculum used to acquire subsequent skills.

title: PolySkill: Learning Generalizable Skills Through Polymorphic Abstraction For Continual Learning

problem: LLM routing must coordinate task planning and multi-round heterogeneous agents rather than select models in isolation.
assumption_broken: Routing can ignore historical interactions, agent roles, and workflow-level decisions.
operational_signature: Encode interactions → select roles → coordinate execution → optimize routing
load_bearing_mechanism: GraphPlanner uses heterogeneous graph memory as the state for reinforcement-learned sequential selection of LLM backbones and agent roles.

improver_modified.how: Reinforcement learning optimizes the routing policy that proposes backbone-and-role choices for workflows.

title: GraphPlanner: Graph Memory-Augmented Agentic Routing for Multi-Agent LLMs

problem: Task-specific prompt tuning overlooks general system instructions that could improve many tasks simultaneously.
assumption_broken: Each task needs its own optimized prompt rather than sharing an optimized system-level instruction.
operational_signature: Assemble instructions → edit candidates → evaluate broadly → evolve instructions
load_bearing_mechanism: SPRIG evolves system prompts through edits to prespecified components, optimizing performance over a collection of diverse tasks.
title: SPRIG: Improving Large Language Model Performance by System Prompt Optimization

problem: Aesthetic prompt enhancement can omit user-requested concepts and degrade semantic image-text alignment.
assumption_broken: Prompt improvements should prioritize style and aesthetics without explicitly inspecting missing semantic content.
operational_signature: Generate outputs → identify omissions → revise semantic units → reassemble instructions
load_bearing_mechanism: VisualPrompter uses visual self-reflection to locate absent concepts and makes atomic, target-specific prompt edits while preserving semantic integrity.
title: VisualPrompter: Semantic-Aware Prompt Optimization with Visual Feedback for Text-to-Image Synthesis

problem: Opaque neural control policies are difficult to interpret, verify, and debug.
assumption_broken: Competitive learned control must use opaque neural policies or a predefined domain-specific language.
operational_signature: Generate programs → observe behavior → diagnose failures → evolve policies
load_bearing_mechanism: MLES combines multimodal LLM program generation and evolutionary search with visual failure analysis that guides targeted policy improvements.
limitations_evident: Reported performance comparison covers two standard control tasks.
title: Multimodal LLM-assisted Evolutionary Search for Programmatic Control Policies

problem: Selecting self-modifying coding agents by current benchmark performance can miss agents with stronger future improvement potential.
assumption_broken: An agent with better current coding performance necessarily produces better subsequent self-modifications.
operational_signature: Estimate descendant potential → prioritize branches → edit self → evaluate descendants
load_bearing_mechanism: HGM estimates clade metaproductivity from descendant benchmark performance to guide search through a tree of agent self-modifications.

improver_modified.how: Coding agents edit their own codebases, changing the agents that generate subsequent self-modifications.

limitations_evident: The stated relationship to the optimal self-improving machine assumes access to true clade metaproductivity and additional assumptions.
title: Huxley-G\"odel Machine: Human-Level Coding Agent Development by an Approximation of the Optimal Self-Improving Machine
Embodied Agents Meet Personalization: Investigating Challenges and Solutions Through the Lens of Memory Utilization
problem: Embodied agents struggle to coordinate personalized memories and apply sequential user routines to planning.
assumption_broken: Episodic experience need not mix personalized knowledge with demonstrations used for in-context learning.
operational_signature: Recall experiences → separate knowledge → organize hierarchically → retrieve for planning
load_bearing_mechanism: A hierarchical knowledge graph user-profile memory separately manages personalized knowledge to reduce overload and coordination failures.

title: SIPDO: Closed-Loop Prompt Optimization via Synthetic Data Feedback
problem: Prompt optimization over fixed data does not expose newly emerging prompt weaknesses during iterative improvement.
assumption_broken: The optimization dataset can evolve alongside the prompt rather than remain fixed.
operational_signature: Generate examples → expose weaknesses → refine instructions → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: A synthetic data generator and prompt optimizer form a feedback loop that generates weakness-revealing examples for incremental prompt refinement.

title: Online Black-Box Prompt Optimization with Regret Guarantees under Noisy Feedback
problem: Online black-box prompt optimization is destabilized by stochastic outputs and high-variance zeroth-order estimates.
assumption_broken: Black-box prompt optimization need not assume offline learning or effectively deterministic feedback.
operational_signature: Perturb candidates → observe noisy feedback → adjust uncertainty scale → update online
load_bearing_mechanism: Uncertainty-scale adjustment stabilizes non-convex online zeroth-order prompt updates under noisy generative feedback.

title: Multi-View Encoders for Performance Prediction in LLM-Based Agentic Workflows
problem: Searching agentic workflow configurations requires too many expensive evaluations.
assumption_broken: Workflow utility can be predicted from multiple structural views instead of measured through exhaustive execution.
operational_signature: Encode multiple views → pretrain representations → predict success → select configurations
load_bearing_mechanism: Cross-domain unsupervised pretraining and joint encoding of code, prompts, and interaction graphs enable data-efficient workflow performance prediction.

title: CALM: Co-evolution of Algorithms and Language Model for Automatic Heuristic Design
problem: Automatic heuristic evolution is limited by language models that remain fixed while prompts guide search.
assumption_broken: The heuristic-generating model can be trained during evolutionary search rather than treated as a fixed proposer.
operational_signature: Generate candidates → evaluate quality → evolve candidates → train generator
load_bearing_mechanism: Reinforcement learning fine-tunes the heuristic generator using generated-heuristic quality while verbal guidance steers evolutionary search.

improver_modified.how: The heuristic-generating LLM is fine-tuned with reinforcement learning using the quality of its generated heuristics.

title: RefTool: Reference-Guided Tool Creation for Knowledge-Intensive Reasoning
problem: Self-generated tools fail when task knowledge lies outside the language model's internal knowledge.
assumption_broken: Tool creation can be grounded in external references rather than solely in model knowledge.
operational_signature: Read references → generate executable artifacts → validate examples → organize and reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Reference-grounded tool generation with example validation and a hierarchical toolbox supports accurate creation and subsequent selection of tools.

title: Darwin Gödel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
problem: Fixed agent architectures and impractical proof requirements prevent autonomous cumulative agent improvement.
assumption_broken: Self-modifications can be evaluated empirically, and exploration need not discard all but the current best agent.
operational_signature: Sample retained variants → modify self → execute evaluations → archive descendants
load_bearing_mechanism: An expanding archive of self-modifying coding agents preserves diverse stepping stones for open-ended empirical improvement.

improver_modified.how: Agents modify their own code, including components that determine their future ability to modify code.

title: ContextBench: Modifying Contexts for Targeted Latent Activation and Behaviour Elicitation
problem: Targeted context generation struggles to elicit latent features or behaviors while preserving linguistic fluency.
assumption_broken: Contexts can be actively edited to target internal activations and behaviors rather than only task answers.
operational_signature: Choose target → edit context → measure elicitation and fluency → refine context
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM assistance and diffusion inpainting enhance gradient-based token editing to balance elicitation strength with fluency.

title: GRACE: A Language Model Framework for Explainable Inverse Reinforcement Learning
problem: Inverse reinforcement learning produces opaque reward models that are hard to interpret and debug.
assumption_broken: Rewards inferred from demonstrations can be executable, inspectable code instead of black-box models.
operational_signature: Observe demonstrations → generate reward code → evolve candidates → train policies
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-driven evolutionary search reverse-engineers interpretable code-based rewards directly from expert trajectories.

title: TIPO: Text to Image with Text Pre-sampling for Prompt Optimization
problem: Automatic text-to-image prompt refinement is often computationally expensive.
assumption_broken: Effective prompt expansion need not require a large model or reinforcement learning.
operational_signature: Receive intent → sample targeted expansions → preserve meaning → generate outputs
load_bearing_mechanism: A lightweight pretrained model samples detailed prompt expansions from a targeted semantic sub-distribution.

title: Textual Equilibrium Propagation for Deep Compound AI Systems
problem: Global textual feedback in deep compound systems grows excessively and loses specificity across many propagation hops.
assumption_broken: Optimizing deep compound systems need not propagate textual feedback backward through the full workflow.
operational_signature: Refine locally → reach equilibrium → nudge bounded edits → propagate objectives forward
load_bearing_mechanism: Local critic-driven equilibrium refinement followed by bounded prompt nudges replaces degrading global backward feedback chains.

title: Prompt and Parameter Co-Optimization for Large Language Models
problem: Independent prompt optimization and fine-tuning leave their complementary gains underexploited.
assumption_broken: Natural-language prompts and model parameters can be optimized jointly rather than in isolation.
operational_signature: Encode jointly → generate instructions and parameters → score supervision → update generators
load_bearing_mechanism: Two prompt and parameter generators share a bottom encoder and are jointly trained with a supervised regularization loss.

improver_modified.how: Supervised signals jointly train the prompt and parameter generators through a shared encoder and regularization loss.

title: Beyond Magic Words: Sharpness-Aware Prompt Evolving for Robust Large Language Models with TARE
problem: Accuracy-focused prompt search yields prompts whose performance changes sharply under meaning-preserving paraphrases.
assumption_broken: Prompt quality should depend on performance across semantic neighborhoods rather than only point-wise accuracy.
operational_signature: Generate candidates → stress with paraphrases → measure neighborhood robustness → select robust candidates
load_bearing_mechanism: Inner adversarial paraphrase search and outer neighborhood-aware robust selection reduce textual sharpness, with adaptive neighborhood shaping in ATARE.

title: Towards Self-Evolving Agent Benchmarks : Validatable Agent Trajectory via Test-Time Exploration
problem: Static agent benchmarks rapidly reach performance ceilings and lack reliable harder task construction.
assumption_broken: Benchmark difficulty can evolve automatically while solvability is supported by reproducible execution trajectories.
operational_signature: Explore proposals → construct harder instances → record trajectories → reproduce and validate
load_bearing_mechanism: Free agent exploration creates harder benchmark tasks whose recorded trajectories undergo multi-level reproducibility and coherence validation.

title: Goedel-Prover-V2: Scaling Formal Theorem Proving with Scaffolded Data Synthesis and Self-Correction
problem: Formal theorem prover improvement plateaus on human questions and needs better training data and correction behavior.
assumption_broken: A prover can synthesize its own increasingly difficult training questions instead of depending on a fixed human question set.
operational_signature: Synthesize scaffolded challenges → attempt proofs → verify and correct → update prover
load_bearing_mechanism: Scaffolded data synthesis renews training difficulty when progress plateaus, complemented by compiler-feedback self-correction and checkpoint averaging.

improver_modified.how: The prover is trained on its own scaffolded synthetic questions and learns self-correction from Lean compiler feedback.

title: Master Skill Learning with Policy-Grounded Synergy of LLM-based Reward Shaping and Exploring
problem: Goal-focused generated rewards and generic exploration bonuses trap robot policies in local optima or waste exploration.
assumption_broken: Reward and exploration-bonus configurations can be evaluated during policy improvement rather than by training each candidate from scratch.
operational_signature: Generate rewards and bonuses → improve policy → filter pairs → adapt exploration
load_bearing_mechanism: Policy-grounded online generation and filtering of reward-bonus pairs jointly adapts task-aware reward shaping and affordance-based exploration.

title: Textual Bayes: Quantifying Prompt Uncertainty in LLM-Based Systems
problem: Black-box LLM pipelines lack principled uncertainty quantification and are sensitive to manually tuned prompts.
assumption_broken: Prompts can be distributions of textual parameters with priors rather than a single optimized instruction.
operational_signature: Express prior beliefs → propose textual parameters → accept probabilistically → aggregate predictions
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-proposed Metropolis-Hastings sampling performs Bayesian inference over prompts using a small training dataset and free-form textual priors.

title: Expanding the Capability Frontier of LLM Agents with ZPD-Guided Data Synthesis
problem: Agent reasoning training lacks data precisely at the frontier of current capabilities.
assumption_broken: Training difficulty can be defined by the gap between independent and guided task solving rather than fixed benchmark difficulty.
operational_signature: Locate capability frontier → synthesize guided challenges → construct training data → train and reevaluate
load_bearing_mechanism: ZPD-guided synthesis produces knowledge data and frontier reasoning trajectories for continued pretraining and post-training.

title: Beyond Pass@ 1: Self-Play with Variational Problem Synthesis Sustains RLVR
problem: Conventional verifiable-reward training improves single-sample accuracy while collapsing entropy and multi-sample reasoning performance.
assumption_broken: Training problems can be continuously augmented during reinforcement learning rather than held fixed.
operational_signature: Solve current problems → synthesize answer-preserving variants → refresh training problems → update policy
load_bearing_mechanism: Online self-play synthesizes variational problems from correct policy solutions while preserving reference answers, sustaining entropy and Pass@k gains.

improver_modified.how: The policy that supplies correct solutions for subsequent problem synthesis is continually updated through RLVR.

title: Risk-Sensitive Agent Compositions
problem: Agent composition must minimize rare safety, fairness, and privacy violations rather than optimize task success alone.
assumption_broken: Feasible agent compositions can be ranked by tail loss instead of only average success.
operational_signature: Enumerate feasible paths → approximate tail loss → propagate dynamic estimates → select composition
load_bearing_mechanism: Dynamic programming exploits a union bound to approximate composition value-at-risk and identify near-optimal agent compositions.
limitations_evident: Workflows are modeled as directed acyclic agent graphs.

title: MAS$^2$: Self-Generative, Self-Configuring, Self-Rectifying Multi-Agent Systems
problem: Automatically generated multi-agent systems are brittle when generated once and deployed without adaptive rectification.
assumption_broken: The system that generates a multi-agent system can itself be a trained team that keeps rectifying its outputs.
operational_signature: Generate architecture → implement agents → observe task demands → rectify composition
load_bearing_mechanism: A generator-implementer-rectifier team trained through Collaborative Tree Optimization recursively creates and adaptively repairs target multi-agent systems.

improver_modified.how: Collaborative Tree Optimization trains and specializes the generator, implementer, and rectifier meta-agents.

title: AgenTracer: Who Is Inducing Failure in the LLM Agentic Systems?
problem: Long multi-agent traces make it difficult to identify the agent and step responsible for failure.
assumption_broken: Failure attribution training labels can be generated through counterfactual replay and injected faults rather than inferred solely by a large reasoning model.
operational_signature: Inject faults → replay counterfactuals → annotate trajectories → train tracer and provide feedback
load_bearing_mechanism: Counterfactual replay and programmed fault injection produce multi-granular training supervision for a lightweight failure tracer.

title: ContextNav: Towards Agentic Multimodal In-Context Learning
problem: Multimodal in-context learning trades scalable retrieval against the quality and robustness of curated examples.
assumption_broken: Context retrieval and toolchain planning can be adaptively curated using downstream feedback rather than remain fixed similarity-based operations.
operational_signature: Embed resources → retrieve examples → align context structure → revise toolchain from feedback
load_bearing_mechanism: Agentic retrieval and structural alignment within an Operational Grammar Graph support closed-loop, noise-robust context construction.

title: What Generative Search Engines Like and How to Optimize Web Content Cooperatively
problem: Content providers lack automated ways to adapt content to generative search preferences without degrading search utility.
assumption_broken: Generative engine preferences can be extracted as explicit rules and reused for optimization rather than handled through ad hoc rewriting.
operational_signature: Explain preferences → extract rules → condition rewrites or train rewriter → optimize content
load_bearing_mechanism: Extracted generative-engine preference rules serve both as context for an API-based rewriter and as rewards for a smaller trained rewriter.

title: K²-Agent: Co-Evolving Know-What and Know-How for Hierarchical Mobile Device Control
problem: Mobile control agents lack task-level experience and reliable low-level skills for long-horizon tasks.
assumption_broken: Declarative planning knowledge and procedural execution skills can be separated and co-evolved rather than learned as an undifferentiated controller.
operational_signature: Bootstrap demonstration → reflect and revise knowledge → train execution curriculum → transfer knowledge and skills
load_bearing_mechanism: An SRLR loop refines declarative knowledge while curriculum-guided GRPO improves procedural skills through balanced sampling and dynamic demonstration injection.

title: MetaFlow: A Meta Approach of Training LLMs into Generalizable Workflow Generators
problem: Automatic workflow generators often produce instance-specific solutions and fail on unfamiliar tasks or operator sets.
assumption_broken: Workflow composition can be learned as a task-level meta-learning capability rather than searched anew for each instance.
operational_signature: Synthesize workflows → train generator → execute across instances → reinforce successful compositions
load_bearing_mechanism: Synthetic-workflow supervised training followed by execution-based RLVR teaches a generator reusable task-level composition patterns.

improver_modified.how: The workflow-generating model is trained with supervised learning and execution-feedback reinforcement learning.

title: Improving Language Agents through BREW: Bootstrapping expeRientially-learned Environmental knoWledge
problem: Weight-based agent optimization is expensive and yields policies that are difficult to interpret or incrementally improve.
assumption_broken: A structured, editable knowledge base can serve as the optimization substrate instead of model weights or static memory context.
operational_signature: Collect experience → grade behavior → partition and refine knowledge → search robust updates
load_bearing_mechanism: Partitioned experiential memory is constructed and refined using task graders, behavioral rubrics, and state-space search to reduce noisy natural-language updates.

title: ToolFuzz: Automated Agent Tool Testing
problem: Incorrect natural-language tool documentation causes agent runtime errors and semantically wrong responses that standard testing misses.
assumption_broken: Tool documentation can be automatically tested and repaired using generated natural-language queries rather than assumed correct.
operational_signature: Generate diverse queries → execute tools → identify failures → repair documentation
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-guided fuzzing discovers runtime and semantic failures that drive an automated tool-documentation improvement pipeline.

title: Learning Progress-Guided LLM Goal Generation for Autotelic Skill Learning
problem: Fixed goal spaces and competence-based goal generation limit diverse, genuinely learnable skill acquisition.
assumption_broken: Interesting or apparently achievable goals need not produce learning progress, so goal generation itself should be optimized for progress.
operational_signature: Generate candidates → measure progress → adapt generation → acquire skills
load_bearing_mechanism: Directly optimizing LLM goal generation for learning progress produces more learnable and diverse curricula than competence-based generation.

title: Unifying Dynamic Tool Creation and Cross-Task Experience Sharing through Cognitive Memory Architecture
problem: Agents inefficiently recreate tools and fail to reuse successful experience across tasks.
assumption_broken: Tool creation and experience reuse need not be separate processes or rely on a fixed tool inventory.
operational_signature: Retrieve experience → generate tools → execute in isolation → preserve reusable knowledge
load_bearing_mechanism: Hierarchical procedural, semantic, and episodic memory unifies sandboxed iterative tool creation with semantically matched cross-task experience retrieval.

title: Sample-Aware Dual Actions for Prompt Optimization
problem: Manual prompt design is costly, and automated search insufficiently uses sample-level performance to guide optimization.
assumption_broken: The overall state of training samples can guide search actions rather than treating prompt search as sample-agnostic.
operational_signature: Evaluate samples → characterize sample state → search alternative actions → refine instructions
load_bearing_mechanism: Sample-aware dual-action Monte Carlo tree search uses individual performance and aggregate sample state to steer prompt optimization.

title: LifelongAgentBench: Evaluating LLM Agents as Lifelong Learners
problem: Static, independent-task benchmarks fail to assess whether agents accumulate and transfer knowledge over time.
assumption_broken: Agent evaluation should test interdependent lifelong learning rather than treating agents as stateless systems.
operational_signature: Sequence interdependent tasks → accumulate experience → aggregate consistent judgments → verify outcomes
load_bearing_mechanism: Skill-grounded interdependent tasks expose lifelong learning failures, while a group self-consistency mechanism improves agent performance.
limitations_evident: Conventional experience replay is limited by irrelevant information and context length.

title: Directed Information $\gamma$-covering: An Information-Theoretic Framework for Context Engineering
problem: Redundant context chunks waste limited context capacity and impair hard-decision retrieval and compression.
assumption_broken: Context representatives can be selected offline without knowing the eventual query by exploiting asymmetric information coverage.
operational_signature: Measure predictiveness → define coverage → greedily select representatives → reuse compressed context
load_bearing_mechanism: Directed-information gamma-covering selects chunks that represent other chunks within bounded information slack while enforcing diversity.

title: h1: Bootstrapping Models to Reason over Longer Horizons via Reinforcement Learning
problem: Long-horizon reasoning degrades while inference scaffolding and step-level supervision are costly to scale.
assumption_broken: Long-horizon reasoning can be trained from existing short-horizon data using outcome rewards rather than additional dense annotations.
operational_signature: Compose simple instances → increase dependency depth → reward outcomes → update capabilities
load_bearing_mechanism: Automatically increasing the complexity of synthetically composed dependency chains sustains outcome-reward reinforcement learning over longer horizons.

title: Language Models Need Sleep: Learning to Self Modify and Consolidate Memories
problem: Language models cannot reliably consolidate temporary in-context knowledge into lasting parameters for continual learning.
assumption_broken: Model capacity and synthetic rehearsal curricula can evolve during consolidation rather than keeping the model fixed after in-context learning.
operational_signature: Collect temporary knowledge → expand capacity → distill memories → rehearse generated curricula
load_bearing_mechanism: RL-based upward distillation into a larger network followed by RL-driven synthetic dreaming consolidates memory and refines capabilities.

improver_modified.how: The model that generates synthetic rehearsal curricula also self-improves through reinforcement learning during dreaming.

title: Framework of Thoughts: A Foundation Framework for Dynamic and Optimized Reasoning based on Chains, Trees, and Graphs
problem: Static problem-specific reasoning structures are difficult to adapt and under-optimized for quality, runtime, and cost.
assumption_broken: Reasoning structures, prompts, and hyperparameters can be dynamically built and optimized rather than specified once per problem.
operational_signature: Compose reasoning structures → tune settings → execute concurrently → reuse cached computations
load_bearing_mechanism: A shared framework combines dynamic reasoning construction with prompt and hyperparameter optimization, parallel execution, and intelligent caching.

title: ToolLibGen: Scalable Automatic Tool Creation and Aggregation for LLM Reasoning
problem: Growing unstructured collections of task-specific tools create retrieval ambiguity and scalability bottlenecks.
assumption_broken: Automatically generated tools need not remain isolated functions; shared logic can be consolidated into a structured library.
operational_signature: Generate functions → cluster related capabilities → refactor shared logic → review functional coverage
load_bearing_mechanism: A code agent aggregates semantically clustered tools while a reviewing agent checks preservation of the original functional capabilities.

title: TrajTune: Trajectory-Based Prompt Optimization for LLM Agents
problem: Agent prompts optimized for text quality fail to prevent hallucinated tool calls, repetitive actions, and execution failures.
assumption_broken: Prompt refinement can be triggered by structured trajectory errors rather than judging only final textual outputs.
operational_signature: Trace execution → measure errors → compare adaptive thresholds → revise instructions
load_bearing_mechanism: Fine-grained execution error metrics exceeding adaptive thresholds trigger a multi-LLM feedback loop for prompt refinement.

title: In-Context Learning for Esoteric Programming Languages: Evaluating and Enhancing LLM Reasoning Without Fine-Tuning
problem: LLMs struggle to infer and use poorly represented esoteric programming languages even with documentation.
assumption_broken: Low-resource language adaptation can reuse verified model-generated examples rather than requiring costly fine-tuning.
operational_signature: Generate solutions → verify manually → select analogues → augment subsequent instructions
load_bearing_mechanism: Manually verified generated solutions become analogous in-context examples that scaffold subsequent code generation without retraining.
limitations_evident: Generated solutions require manual verification.
Performance remains far below that in common programming languages.

title: Unified Plan Verification with Static Rubrics and Dynamic Policies for Reliable LLM Planning
problem: Plausible but flawed plans and undetected runtime conflicts undermine reliable multi-step agent execution.
assumption_broken: Plan validation and execution control can use explicit rubrics and learned symbolic rules instead of opaque judging or purely reactive behavior.
operational_signature: Instantiate checks → revise plans → inspect execution context → apply learned control rules
load_bearing_mechanism: Pre-execution binary rubric verification complements a runtime rulebook optimized through MCTS-style discrete prompt search without weight updates.

title: Revisiting Prompt Optimization with Large Reasoning Models---A Case Study on Event Extraction
problem: It is unclear whether strong reasoning models still need prompt optimization or improve its effectiveness.
assumption_broken: Strong intermediate reasoning does not eliminate the benefits of optimizing task instructions and guidelines.
operational_signature: Choose optimizer and task models → refine instructions → evaluate task outputs → compare model pairings
load_bearing_mechanism: Using reasoning models as prompt optimizers produces more effective task instructions, and reasoning task models still benefit from optimization.

title: Exposing Hidden Biases in Text-to-Image Models via Automated Prompt Search
problem: Curated prompt sets overlook subtle prompts that elicit social biases from text-to-image models, including debiased models.
assumption_broken: Bias-triggering prompts can be automatically searched using internal image-model representations rather than confined to curated prompts.
operational_signature: Generate neutral candidates → score internal attributes → steer decoding → expose biased outputs
load_bearing_mechanism: Attribute classifiers on diffusion-model representations guide LLM decoding toward interpretable attribute-neutral prompts that amplify biased image generation.

title: Ladders of Thought: A Self-Evolving Curriculum of Progressively Simplified Reasoning Traces
problem: Small and mid-scale language models remain brittle reasoners despite knowledge distillation.
assumption_broken: Reasoning training need not use fixed problem difficulty or a predetermined curriculum schedule.
operational_signature: Simplify instances → bucket difficulty → adapt training allocation → strengthen reasoning
load_bearing_mechanism: Semantically faithful easier problem rewrites combine with a self-evolving bandit scheduler that adaptively allocates training across difficulty buckets.
limitations_evident: Multi-hop reasoning benefits depend on the dataset.

title: Strategic Self-Improvement for Competitive Agents in AI Labour Markets
problem: Competitive economic agents must improve skills and strategies as rivals and market conditions change.
assumption_broken: Agent self-improvement in markets depends on strategic self-assessment and rival modeling rather than task skill alone.
operational_signature: Assess capabilities → model competitors → plan over time → adapt skills and strategies
load_bearing_mechanism: Explicit prompts for metacognition, competitive awareness, and long-horizon planning improve strategic self-improvement in a simulated gig economy.

title: ACT: AGENTIC CLASSIFICATION TREE
problem: Free-form LLM reasoning lacks auditable decision paths, while conventional decision trees cannot directly process unstructured text.
assumption_broken: Decision-tree splits can be natural-language questions optimized with LLM feedback rather than only structured feature thresholds.
operational_signature: Propose split questions → measure impurity → obtain feedback → refine branching decisions
load_bearing_mechanism: Natural-language decision-tree splits are refined using impurity-based evaluation and TextGrad feedback to combine classification quality with interpretable paths.

title: GeoEvolve: Automating Geospatial Model Discovery via Multi-Agent Large Language Models
problem: Generic LLM code evolution lacks the geospatial knowledge needed for heterogeneous and temporally non-stationary modeling.
assumption_broken: Domain priors can be dynamically retrieved and injected into evolutionary discovery rather than relying solely on generic code generation.
operational_signature: Retrieve theoretical priors → generate code → evaluate candidates → steer further evolution
load_bearing_mechanism: Nested code-evolution and agentic-control loops use dynamically constructed geospatial knowledge and code-to-formula analysis to guide candidate discovery.

title: VRPAgent: LLM-Driven Discovery of Heuristic Operators for Vehicle Routing Problems
problem: LLM-generated vehicle-routing heuristics struggle to match expert designs when asked to generate complete solutions.
assumption_broken: The search can optimize problem-specific operators inside a generic metaheuristic instead of synthesizing an entire heuristic at once.
operational_signature: Generate operators → embed in a fixed scaffold → evaluate routes → evolve operator candidates
load_bearing_mechanism: Genetic refinement of LLM-generated operators within a correctness-preserving generic metaheuristic makes discovery manageable and effective.

title: OpenSIR: Open-Ended Self-Improving Reasoner
problem: Reasoning RL depends on annotated problems or external verifiers and struggles to sustain open-ended self-play learning.
assumption_broken: One model can co-evolve problem generation and solving from a trivial seed without external supervision.
operational_signature: Generate challenges → solve them → reward difficulty and diversity → update alternating roles
load_bearing_mechanism: Co-evolving teacher and student roles calibrate problem difficulty while rewarding conceptual diversity to sustain autonomous mathematical learning.

improver_modified.how: The same LLM alternates between teacher and student roles, and its problem-generating teacher role co-evolves during self-play.

title: CoolPrompt: An Automatic Prompt Optimization Framework for Large Language Models
problem: Manual prompt engineering requires expertise and produces time-consuming, subjective, and often suboptimal results.
assumption_broken: Prompt optimization can automate task and metric selection and handle missing annotations without manual configuration.
operational_signature: Infer tasks and metrics → prepare or synthesize data → optimize instructions → collect feedback
load_bearing_mechanism: A zero-configuration workflow integrates data preparation with ReflectivePrompt, DistillPrompt, and HyPE meta-prompting for automated optimization.

title: Structuring Collective Action with LLM-Guided Evolution: From Ill-Structured Problems to Executable Heuristics
problem: Ill-structured collective action problems obscure how individual choices can align conflicting incentives with collective welfare.
assumption_broken: Collective coordination can be transformed into executable local policies and persuasive rationales rather than requiring agents to solve global complexity directly.
operational_signature: Propose behavioral rules → simulate collective outcomes → retain effective variants → evolve adoption messages
load_bearing_mechanism: Two-stage LLM-guided evolution pairs executable behavioral heuristics with companion messages, selecting populations for collective simulated performance.

title: EvoMAS : Heuristics in the Loop—Evolving Smarter Agentic Workflows
problem: Manual and automated multi-agent design struggle with rigid templates, monolithic optimization, and varying task complexity.
assumption_broken: Agent roles, collaboration patterns, evolutionary operators, and curriculum progression can evolve together instead of remaining fixed.
operational_signature: Partition by difficulty → adapt mutation strategies → specialize collaborating roles → reflectively revise control rules
load_bearing_mechanism: Adaptive evolutionary operators and role-level optimization are coordinated across a difficulty curriculum by a reflectively updated Cyber Creator controller.

improver_modified.how: The Cyber Creator meta-control system dynamically formulates rules and reflectively updates its control of the evolutionary process.

title: InjecMEM: Memory Injection Attack on LLM Agent Memory Systems
problem: Agent memory can preserve adversarial interactions that later redirect responses to related queries without direct memory-store access.
assumption_broken: A single interaction can poison subsequent memory retrieval and generation even when attackers cannot read or edit the store.
operational_signature: Construct retrieval cues → optimize context-robust commands → inject a record → redirect later responses
load_bearing_mechanism: A retriever-agnostic topical anchor is paired with a command optimized by gradient-based coordinate search across synthetic contexts and insertion positions.

title: Meta-Prompt Optimization for LLM-Based Sequential Decision Making
problem: Non-stationary reward observations make fixed-meta-prompt optimization difficult for LLM sequential decision-making agents.
assumption_broken: Task descriptions, meta-instructions, and interaction exemplars can adapt online rather than remaining manually fixed.
operational_signature: Observe rewards → update exponential weights → select instructions and exemplars → act again
load_bearing_mechanism: An adversarial-bandit-inspired exponential-weight algorithm adapts meta-prompts to non-stationary rewards, with EXPO-ES additionally optimizing interaction exemplars.

title: MLE-RL: Reinforcement Learning for Self-Improvement in Machine Learning Agents
problem: Long execution times, iterative development, and context limits hinder cumulative improvement in machine-learning engineering agents.
assumption_broken: Long development trajectories can be learned as informative single-step optimizations rather than optimized only as whole trajectories.
operational_signature: Execute development attempts → select informative steps → update policy → recall high-performing solutions
load_bearing_mechanism: Selective single-step reinforcement learning is paired with a memory scaffold that stores and recalls high-performing prior solutions.

improver_modified.how: Reinforcement learning updates the coding agent policy using selected informative steps from its development attempts.

title: DéjàQ: Open-Ended Evolution of Diverse, Learnable and Verifiable Problems
problem: Static mathematical training datasets risk memorization and fail to adapt problem difficulty to a model improving during training.
assumption_broken: Training problems can co-evolve with the reasoning model instead of remaining a fixed external dataset.
operational_signature: Mutate contexts or structures → assess learnability → evolve problem sets → train the generator-solver
load_bearing_mechanism: The model mutates problem context or structure to evolve diverse synthetic problems matched to its changing ability during reinforcement learning.

improver_modified.how: The model that mutates synthetic problems is itself trained while the problem population evolves.

title: LLM-Guided Search for Deletion-Correcting Codes
problem: Constructing maximum-size deletion-correcting codes remains difficult even for small deletion counts.
assumption_broken: Greedy construction order can be discovered by evolving priority-function programs rather than relying only on handcrafted code constructions.
operational_signature: Generate priority functions → greedily construct feasible sets → measure size → evolve improved functions
load_bearing_mechanism: FunSearch evolves sequence-priority functions whose greedy ordering yields larger constraint-satisfying deletion-correcting codes.

title: Cogito, Ergo Ludo: An Agent that Learns to Play by Reasoning and Planning
problem: Learning complex environments through reinforcement learning requires extensive experience and hides acquired knowledge in neural weights.
assumption_broken: An agent can learn explicit rules and strategies in language instead of encoding all learning in model weights.
operational_signature: Interact → inspect trajectories → infer rules → summarize strategies → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Episode-level reflection concurrently refines an explicit dynamics model and an actionable strategic playbook.

title: Transferring Jailbreak Attacks from Public to Private LLMs via Local Prompt Optimization
problem: Optimization-based jailbreaks are difficult to apply to private models accessible only through query APIs.
assumption_broken: Gradient-informed attack optimization can be performed locally without accessing private model parameters.
operational_signature: Query → align distributions → optimize locally → transfer
load_bearing_mechanism: An auxiliary adversarial suffix aligns public and private output distributions to support transferable local prompt optimization.

title: Online-Optimized RAG for Tool Use and Function Calling
problem: Misaligned query and tool-description embeddings cause retrieval errors and downstream task failures.
assumption_broken: Retrieval embeddings can adapt during deployment rather than remaining fixed after initialization.
operational_signature: Retrieve → execute → observe feedback → update embeddings → retrieve
